content.comment_body: I'm using a [product_name] with article number [article_no], and while trying to monitor it online with [product_name] [version_no], I get a hardware type mismatch error. How can I determine whether it is [article_no] or [version_no] or another model? Thanks.
The [product_name] with order number [article_no] is the latest [version_no], so you should choose [version_no] in the device selection.
That solved the issue. Thank you very much.

analysis.insight_summary: The user faced a hardware type mismatch error when monitoring a [product_name] using [product_name] [version_no] software. The confusion was due to uncertainty about the correct hardware type to select in the software for the specific device model. The reply clarified the right selection, which resolved the issue and enabled proper device recognition.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants an easy way to identify the correct hardware type to ensure online monitoring works smoothly in the software, preferably with clear guidance on hardware and software compatibility.
